title: Home Purchase Agreement: Last Day of a Closing Delay Period
content:
**§ 12A. End of a closing delay period.** On a Home Purchase Agreement, the day a closing delay period ends depends on what has taken over from the buyer delay:

(1) where the agreement ledger carries a closing extension fee charge dated after the scheduled closing date, the delay period ends on the day before the latest such charge date;

(2) where no such charge stands and a default notice dated after the scheduled closing date has been sent, the delay period ends on the date of the latest default notice;

(3) in every other case neither entry moves the end of the delay period.

**Records read.** The closing extension fee charges and their dates, and the default notices and their dates, as they appear on the agreement ledger, each compared with the scheduled closing date on the agreement.

**Precedence.** Paragraph (1) governs whenever a closing extension fee charge dated after the scheduled closing date stands, whether or not a default notice has also been sent. A closing extension fee charge dated on or before the scheduled closing date, and a default notice dated on or before it, do not count under this section.

**Annotations (hypothetical dates; scheduled closing date 1 May).**

| Ledger shows | End of the delay period |
|---|---|
| Closing extension fee charges dated 20 April and 12 May | 11 May (the day before 12 May, the latest charge date) |
| Closing extension fee charge dated 12 May and a default notice dated 5 June | 11 May |
| No closing extension fee charge after 1 May; default notices dated 2 June and 9 June | 9 June (the latest default notice) |
| Closing extension fee charge dated 20 April only; no default notice | Not moved by either entry |
| Neither entry after 1 May | Not moved by either entry |
